# youtrack_user_group (Resource)

Manages a YouTrack user group. Requires YouTrack 2026.1 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "youtrack_user_group" "all_users" {
  name = "All Users"
}

resource "youtrack_user_group" "support_agents" {
  name               = "Support Agents"
  successor_group_id = data.youtrack_user_group.all_users.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the group.

### Optional

- `successor_group_id` (String) Database ID of the group that takes over the permissions and visibility settings of this group when it is deleted. YouTrack requires it, so the group can only be destroyed if it is set.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Database ID of the group.
- `ring_id` (String) ID of the group in Hub.
